answer: A farm of 35 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are written down in mesa, queued in timber, and wander publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 63 identities per epoch. A farm of 2450 identities would post 2951 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
